name: Cleans Up
description: Germanium with the fuzz part way: dig in for fuzz, play softly or turn the guitar down for a rough crunch.

name: Fuzz Bass
description: Germanium at full quality on a bass: fuzz on the notes, less folding back from the highs.

name: Silicon Grit
description: Silicon at half: a gritty rhythm fuzz that keeps the chords apart.

name: Silicon Lead
description: Silicon, full up: more gain and a brighter, more even edge for a singing lead.

name: Sixties Wall
description: Germanium, the fuzz full up: the thick, lopsided buzz of the late sixties, its bass thinned a little.
